messages:
maya: Quick question — who is allowed to approve PR #4123? It touches infra/k8s/manifests and pkg/runtime/cache. CODEOWNERS seems to point infra -> @infra-owners but runtime files are owned by @runtime-owners. I need to merge this before Mon morning, any way to speed approvals?

sam: If both paths are changed, both owner groups should be requested. CODEOWNERS auto-assigns based on path, but it won't auto-approve. You need an explicit LGTM from each team.

carlos: FWIW the most-specific path wins when matching, but when multiple files in a PR match different entries, multiple owners get requested. So you'll likely see reviewers from both teams.

maya: Ah ok. On the PR it only shows infra owners right now. I think because the runtime change is a single small helper file under pkg/runtime/cache. Is there a way to make it request runtime owners too?

sam: It should if the file path exactly matches CODEOWNERS entries. Can you paste the paths? Also check for typos (trailing slash vs none).

maya: Paths changed: infra/k8s/manifests/deploy.yaml and pkg/runtime/cache/kv_cache.go

codeowner-bot: CODEOWNERS excerpt:
```
/infra/ @infra-owners
/pkg/runtime/ @runtime-owners
```

lisa: I can take infra review this afternoon. For runtime, I suggest adding @runtime-owners as reviewers manually (GitHub reviewers) — that triggers a ping. We don't generally approve runtime changes for other teams.

maya: Cool, I'll add runtime owners as reviewers. If they don't respond, is it acceptable to split the PR into two so infra can land and runtime follow-up?

sam: Splitting is fine if changes are independent. If runtime change is purely a refactor/helpers used only by infra manifests, keep together and ask for cross-team review. If unrelated, split to unblock infra.

carlos: Also note: if you need an expedited approval, drop a short note in #eng-oncall or DM a runtime owner — but document the reason in the PR. Don't ask people to bypass CODEOWNERS.

maya: Got it. Added @runtime-owners to reviewers and left a note about the deadline + test results. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 :pray:

lisa: 👍 I'll review infra side tonight. If you split, ping me so I can merge after CI.

sam: I'll nudge a runtime owner in DM after lunch. No guarantees but I can try.

maya: Thanks all — will update here once I have both LGTM or if I split.

codeowner-bot: CI status: all checks passed on commit 9f3a2b1.

maya: Update — runtime owner replied, requested one tiny change. Pushed fix, awaiting final LGTM. ETA ~30m.

lisa: Great, I can merge after final LGTM and green CI. :shipit:
